A5ft traversal therefore costs5 times that sum; difficult+squeeze costs15ft, not20ft. A body must fit both the 5-foot width and 8-foot height under current posture/clearance rules. old.title: Alignment Portal physical gateway, legal squeeze, forced Medium crossing and ward/fall geometry
old.currentInitialState: Wizard9 opens Alignment Portal from P-A to known compatible site S on P-B. Origin aperture base-center(0,0,0), outward normal east; destination base-center(100,100,0), outward normal north, with clear supported 10x10 staging. Traveler L is Large, footprint10x10, height7.5ft in a posture that can pass the8ft opening, Speed30; No Escape active. Separate Medium M footprint5x5,height6 stands immediately west of origin aperture. Separate eligible warded creature F is falling unsupported toward a P-B Planar Protection sphere.
actionsAndResolution: Portal formation is legal even if a Dimensional Anchor exists elsewhere; formation itself transports nothing. This fixture has no Anchor at formation.
L voluntary crossing is blocked by No Escape before movement because it is voluntary extradimensional travel. Verdict Absolute/Reign of Ashes would not block on teleport wording alone.

Without No Escape, L's 10ft width uses legal one-size-smaller squeeze through the5ft aperture; stated height7.5≤8. Crossing the5ft gateway path costs10ft movement under squeeze (+1 per foot). Destination has a full supported10x10 fitting footprint; squeeze penalties remain for the traversal.

Forced branch uses fitting Medium M, not L. An adjacent attacker uses an actual Shove replacing one attack, wins the opposed contest, and pushes M exactly5ft east along a clear straight path through the aperture. M physically fits 5x8 with no squeeze. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement and No Escape's voluntary clause does not block; destination ward/Anchor/occupancy/support gates still apply.
F's continuous unsupported Fall Marker is not suspended by Planar Protection; AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03 permits the continuous unsupported fall to cross inward and then treats F as already inside.
old.currentAdjudication: Alignment Portal is genuine physical planar transit. Large voluntary crossing uses stated fit/squeeze costs; the forced example uses a fitting Medium body and actual 5-ft Shove rather than inventing squeeze authority for forced movement.

replacement.title: Alignment Portal physical gateway, legal squeeze, forced Medium crossing and ward/fall geometry
replacement.currentInitialState: Wizard9 opens Alignment Portal from P-A to known compatible site S on P-B. Origin aperture base-center(0,0,0), outward normal east; destination base-center(100,100,0), outward normal north, with clear supported 10x10 staging. Traveler L is Large, footprint10x10, height7.5ft in a posture that can pass the8ft opening, Speed30; No Escape active. Separate Medium M footprint5x5,height6 stands immediately west of origin aperture. Separate eligible warded creature F is falling unsupported toward a P-B Planar Protection sphere.
actionsAndResolution: Portal formation is legal even if a Dimensional Anchor exists elsewhere; formation itself transports nothing. This fixture has no Anchor at formation.
L voluntary crossing is blocked by No Escape before movement because it is voluntary extradimensional travel. Verdict Absolute/Reign of Ashes would not block on teleport wording alone.

Without No Escape, L's 10ft width uses legal one-size-smaller squeeze through the5ft aperture; stated height7.5≤8. Crossing the5ft gateway path costs10ft movement under squeeze (+1 per foot). Destination has a full supported10x10 fitting footprint; squeeze penalties remain for the traversal.

In an independent difficult-terrain version of that same voluntary squeezed5ft crossing, cost is5*(2 terrain+1 squeeze)=15ft. With additional crawling it is5*(2+1+1)=20ft. These are accepted per-foot additions, not multiplying difficult2 by squeeze2. No extra terrain cost is imposed on a forced displacement unless its own source says so.

Forced branch uses fitting Medium M, not L. An adjacent attacker uses an actual Shove replacing one attack, wins the opposed contest, and pushes M exactly5ft east along a clear straight path through the aperture. M physically fits 5x8 with no squeeze. Forced movement spends no voluntary movement and No Escape's voluntary clause does not block; destination ward/Anchor/occupancy/support gates still apply.
F's continuous unsupported Fall Marker is not suspended by Planar Protection; AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03 permits the continuous unsupported fall to cross inward and then treats F as already inside.
replacement.currentAdjudication: Alignment Portal is genuine physical planar transit. Large voluntary crossing uses stated fit/squeeze costs; the forced example uses a fitting Medium body and actual 5-ft Shove rather than inventing squeeze authority for forced movement.
replacement.evidenceKind: authored adjudication example; not runtime/human/balance test
